subject_line: An Author Spotlight for The Fall
email_body:
Hi Tina,

I enjoyed learning about The Fall, the first book in your The Pieces We Become series, and the way your stories center on healing, courage, and finding your voice again. Your piece on what Kintsugi teaches us about healing also stood out to me.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author. Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

If a short trailer or a few promotional reels for The Fall is something you have been considering, we can handle the full production. A visual piece like that can give readers a quick feel for the mood and emotion of the story and gives you something easy to share on Instagram and your website. It is entirely optional and can be added to the Spotlight or done on its own.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit The Fall best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
The Author Ledger
